title: Gardenio — Fleet Lifecycle & Throughput

panels.title: Session-duration distribution (heatmap)
panels.description: Full distribution of agent session wall-clock durations over time, from gardenio_agent_session_duration_seconds_bucket ({project,role,outcome}; buckets 5s..1d). The heatmap shows where the mass sits — a bright band creeping toward the 4h/12h buckets means sessions are running long. Filter by $project / $role. Pairs with the percentile panel to the right.

panels.title: Session-duration p50 / p95 / p99 by role
panels.description: histogram_quantile over gardenio_agent_session_duration_seconds_bucket, split by role. p50 is the typical session; p95/p99 expose the long-running tail (a gardener loop or a stuck agent). A role whose p99 rides the 12h/1d ceiling is a candidate for a stop-gate or budget review.

panels.title: Session outcome mix over time (done / failed / killed)
panels.description: Rate of session closes by outcome, from the _count series of gardenio_agent_session_duration_seconds ({project,role,outcome}). Stacked so the share of failed/killed vs done is legible at a glance — a rising non-done band is a fleet-health regression.

panels.title: Beads-events rate by event × bead_type
panels.description: The fleet's core throughput KPI. Uses the vmalert recording rule gardenio:beads_events:rate5m (= sum by (event,project,bead_type) rate(gardenio_beads_events_total[5m])), re-aggregated here by event × bead_type. Shows the create/claim/close/comment shape of fleet work; a collapse to zero on the closed event is a delivery stall.

panels.title: Beads-events rate by event (headline)
panels.description: The same recording rule collapsed to event only — the fleet's headline create/claim/close/comment throughput. Read alongside the by-bead_type breakdown to the left.

panels.title: Authz-denial rate by action × reason
panels.description: Rate of write-authorization rejections from gardenio_authz_denials_total ({action,reason,bead_type}; reason ∈ insufficient_role|project_mismatch|escalation_required|denied). A rising insufficient_role/project_mismatch curve is a real permissions-drift signal — agents being blocked from writes they expect to make. Note: this metric carries no project/env label, so it is fleet-wide (not filtered by $project).

panels.title: Authz denials by action × reason × bead_type (window)
panels.description: Total write-authorization rejections over the dashboard window, broken out by action, reason, and request bead_type (allowlisted; overflow collapses to "custom"). The triage table for permissions drift — sort by Count to see the dominant denial shape.

panels.title: Freeze / thaw latency — the emitting side (ka-0000000045 #4)

options.content:
### Freeze / thaw latency — the emitting side
> **⚠ No freeze traffic in the selected range — empty is the healthy state, not a broken panel.** The `gardenio_freeze_latency_seconds` histogram and the `gardenio_freeze_payload_incomplete_total` / `gardenio_freeze_payload_symlink_skip_total` counters are **wired in the controller** (`NewFreezeMetrics` → `RecordFreezeLatency` / `recordFreezePayload`, `cmd/controller/main.go`), but the whole `gardenio_freeze_*` family only produces series **once a gVisor freeze actually fires** — today only the near-idle `gvisor-poc` canary in prod freezes, so the two panels below routinely read empty.

**Read it honestly.** A blank *Freeze latency p95* panel means *no freeze ran in this window*, **not** that freezes are slow or the emitter is dark. A blank *wasted-payload rate* panel is the **all-clear**: bars appear only when a freeze publishes a genuinely incomplete `/work` or `/tmp` payload (`reason=work_copy|tmp_copy|gofer|gofer_malformed`); benign dangling-symlink noise is split off into `gardenio_freeze_payload_symlink_skip_total` so `rate() > 0` here is always a real wasted-freeze signal. This banner mirrors the honest-empty convention on the VPA-right-sizing board (ka-0000001310).

panels.title: Freeze latency p95 by step × runtime
panels.description: histogram_quantile(0.95) over gardenio_freeze_latency_seconds_bucket ({step,role,runtime,env}; step=runsc-checkpoint|relocation|persist|total). Shows which step dominates freeze cost (the ~3.0G image write vs the relocation copy vs persist) so C3 freeze-speed work is data-driven. Pairs with the (dead) resume-latency board from the side that IS emitting. Metric has no project label — fleet-wide.

defaults.noValue: awaiting freeze traffic — the gardenio_freeze_latency_seconds histogram is wired, but nothing was recorded in the selected range (the gVisor canary in prod is near-idle). An empty panel cannot separate an idle canary from a controller exporter that stopped — confirm with `up{component="agents"} == 1`.

panels.title: Freeze wasted-payload rate by reason (incomplete freezes)
panels.description: Rate of freezes published with a GENUINELY incomplete workspace payload, from gardenio_freeze_payload_incomplete_total ({reason,role,runtime,env}; reason=work_copy|tmp_copy|gofer|gofer_malformed). A non-zero rate is a real wasted-freeze / cold-start-at-thaw signal (benign dangling-symlink noise is deliberately excluded). Should sit at zero.

defaults.noValue: awaiting freeze traffic — the gardenio_freeze_payload_incomplete_total counter is wired, but nothing was recorded in the selected range. Bars appear only when a freeze publishes an incomplete payload; a blank panel does not prove none did, so confirm with `up{component="agents"} == 1` before reading it as clean.

panels.title: LLM & tool-call latency — lights up on traffic (ka-0000000045 #16/#17)
LLM request-latency heatmap
panels.description: End-to-end LLM API request-latency distribution over time, from gardenio_agent_llm_request_latency_seconds_bucket ({agent_name,project,account}), emitted by coop per response. Buckets are registered fleet-wide but may show sparse recent observations — the panel is drawn now so it lights up the moment traffic flows. Filtered by $project.

panels.title: Tool-call latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: histogram_quantile over gardenio_agent_tool_call_latency_seconds_bucket ({agent_name,project,account}), emitted by coop between ToolBefore→ToolAfter. Surfaces which tool calls are slow as traffic flows. Buckets are registered fleet-wide; drawn now so it lights up on traffic. Filtered by $project.

panels.title: Lifecycle events — full transition mix (C8 ka-0000000550)
Lifecycle events by kind (spawned / started / stopped / stuck / drained / despawned / oom_killed)
panels.description: gardenio_agent_lifecycle_events_total rate by event. Until C8 (ka-0000000550) only spawned/stopped/despawned/oom_killed had emitters; now started (pod witnessed Pending→Running), stuck (stagnation heuristic fired, pod restarted), and drained (graceful commit+push drain opened, node-reclaim or spec-drift upgrade) complete the enum. spawned≫started gap = pods created but never reaching Running; a stuck burst = agents wedging; drained tracks reclaim/rollout pressure.

panels.title: Stuck + drained (24h)
panels.description: Agents flagged stuck (restarted by the stagnation heuristic) and agents put through a graceful drain (node reclaim or upgrade) in the last 24h. Both were previously uncounted.

description: Agent session lifecycle end to end: session-duration distribution and percentiles by role, outcome mix (done / failed / killed), bead-event and authz-denial rates, freeze/thaw latency, and spawn→stop lifecycle events. Open this to see whether agents are living, finishing and handing off as expected.
